item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Hits Back at Kim Min-seok: “Worst Kind of Self-Serving Politics is Leaving the Party and Running as an Independent” (정청래 “최악의 자기정치는 탈당·무소속 출마” 김민석에 반격)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Hits Back at Kim Min-seok: “Worst Kind of Self-Serving Politics is Leaving the Party and Running as an Independent” (정청래 “최악의 자기정치는 탈당·무소속 출마” 김민석에 반격)

Former Democratic Party of Korea leader Jung Cheong-rae directly refuted criticism of “self-serving politics” raised during the competition for party leadership. (정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표가 당권 경쟁 과정에서 제기된 ‘자기 정치’ 비판에 정면으로 반박했다.)

On the 12th, Jung wrote on Facebook, “The worst kind of self-serving politics is the outdated practice of leaving the party during elections to run as an independent or supporting a candidate from another party. Even when I was unjustly cut from nominations, I led the ‘Bigger Victory Campaign’ for the party’s success and prioritized the party before myself.” He added, “Who has been engaging in self-serving politics?” (정 전 대표는 12일 페이스북에 “최악의 자기정치는 선거 때 탈당해서 무소속 출마하거나 남의 당 후보를 돕는 구태정치”라며 “나는 억울한 컷오프로 공천 탈락했어도 당의 승리를 위해 더컸유세단을 이끌며 뛰었다. 선당후사했다”고 적었다. 이어 “누가 자기정치를 했는가”라고 했다.)

Jung’s post came as the race for party leadership heats up ahead of the August 17 Democratic Party convention, with contenders including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil. After former PM Kim criticized Jung, saying, “The damage from your self-serving politics over the past year has thrown party-government cooperation into confusion,” the two sides have been locked in a debate over “self-serving politics.” (정 전 대표의 글은 8·17 민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 김민석 전 국무총리, 송영길 의원 등과 당권 경쟁이 본격화하는 가운데 나왔다. 김 전 총리가 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “지난 1년 자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”고 비판한 뒤 양측의 공방은 ‘자기 정치’ 논쟁으로 번졌다.)

In recent public remarks and social media posts, Jung has emphasized his role as someone who stayed with the Democratic Party without leaving. During a lecture at Chosun University in Gwangju on the 10th, he stated, “I was the one who protected President Lee Jae-myung, and Jung Cheong-rae is the one who will protect him to the end.” He also promoted a so-called “four-fold integration,” encompassing supporters of Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung, highlighting the party’s legitimacy and unity. (정 전 대표는 최근 공개 발언과 SNS를 통해 자신이 민주당을 떠나지 않고 당을 지켜온 인물이라는 점을 부각하고 있다. 그는 10일 광주 조선대 강연에서도 “이재명 대통령을 지킨 것도 저고, 끝까지 지킬 사람도 정청래”라고 말했다. 또 김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명 대통령 지지층을 아우르는 이른바 ‘4통 통합’을 내세우며 당내 정통성과 결속을 강조했다.)

Former PM Kim has focused on party-government cooperation and a pragmatic, livelihood-centered approach. In his campaign declaration, he emphasized “complete party-government alignment and a pragmatic, integrated livelihood-focused line,” indirectly criticizing Jung’s leadership for failing to effectively translate government support into party approval and electoral outcomes. Lawmaker Song Young-gil also took a veiled swipe at Jung, saying, “We need to elect a leader who will cooperate with the Lee Jae-myung administration, not just a flashy one.” (김 전 총리는 당정 협력과 민생 실용 노선을 앞세우고 있다. 그는 출마 선언에서 “완벽한 당정 일치와 민생실용 통합 노선”을 강조했고, 정 전 대표 체제에서 국정 지지가 정당 지지와 선거 결과로 충분히 연결되지 못했다는 취지로 비판했다. 송영길 의원도 “선명한 사람 아닌 이재명 정부와 협력할 대표를 뽑아야 한다”며 정 전 대표를 우회적으로 겨냥했다.)

The leadership race is also intertwined with a debate over election rules. Within and outside the Democratic Party, tensions are rising between Jung’s camp and other candidates over whether to introduce a preferential voting system. Jung expressed discomfort with what he described as a “two-against-one or three-against-one” dynamic aimed at checking him, while Song countered, “It’s not right for a player on the field to complain about the rules.” (당권 경쟁은 선거 룰 논쟁과도 맞물려 있다. 민주당 안팎에서는 선호투표제 도입 여부를 두고 친청계와 다른 주자들 사이의 신경전이 이어지고 있다. 정 전 대표는 자신을 향한 견제 구도를 ‘2대 1, 3대 1’ 구도로 표현하며 불편한 기색을 드러냈고, 송 의원은 “경기장에 선 선수가 룰을 문제 삼는 것은 옳은 태도가 아니다”라고 맞섰다.)

item.title: Unification Ministry Requests North Korea's Cooperation in Search and Repatriation of Missing Navy Soldier in East Sea (통일부, 동해 해군장병 실종에 “수색·송환 관련 대북 협조 요청”)
item.description:
Unification Ministry Requests North Korea's Cooperation in Search and Repatriation of Missing Navy Soldier in East Sea (통일부, 동해 해군장병 실종에 “수색·송환 관련 대북 협조 요청”)

The Unification Ministry stated on the 12th that it has requested North Korea's cooperation in search and repatriation efforts, in case a missing navy soldier from the East Sea's northern waters may have drifted north of the Northern Limit Line (NLL). (통일부는 12일 동해 북단 해상에서 실종된 해군 장병이 북방한계선(NLL) 이북 지역으로 표류했을 가능성에 대비해 북한에 수색·송환 협조를 요청한다고 밝혔다.)

In a press notice issued that day, the Unification Ministry announced, "One navy soldier aboard a naval vessel conducting patrol duties in the East Sea has gone missing and appears to have possibly drifted into areas north of the NLL," adding, "We have requested North Korea's cooperation from a humanitarian perspective in the search and repatriation of the missing personnel." (통일부는 이날 ‘언론 공지’를 통해 “동해 해상에서 경비 임무 수행 중인 해군 함정 병사 1명이 실종돼 NLL(북방한계선) 이북 지역으로 표류 가능성이 있는 것으로 보인다”며 “인도주의적 견지에서 실종자 수색과 송환에 (북한이) 협조해주기를 요청했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Unification Ministry explained that since all communication channels with North Korea are currently severed, the cooperation request is being conveyed through the media. (통일부는 현재 대북 소통 채널이 모두 단절돼 언론을 통해 협조요청 메시지를 전달하는 것이라고 설명했다.)

Earlier, the Navy reported, "A crew member (soldier) from a naval vessel conducting patrol duties in the waters approximately 50 km east of Geojin-eup, Goseong-gun, in the East Sea this morning has gone missing." (앞서 해군은 이날 “오늘 오전 동해 고성군 거진읍 동방 50여㎞ 해상에서 경비 임무 수행 중인 해군 함정 승조원(병사) 1명이 실종됐다”고 밝혔다.)

The Navy, in coordination with the Coast Guard, has deployed vessels and aircraft to search for the missing soldier. (해군은 해경과 합동으로 함정과 항공기 등을 투입해 실종된 병사를 탐색 중이다.)

item.title: First ROK-U.S. Joint Tabletop Exercise Conducted to Block 'Disinformation' in Crises (유사시 ‘허위정보’ 유포 차단…첫 한미 합동 도상훈련 실시)
item.description:
First ROK-U.S. Joint Tabletop Exercise Conducted to Block 'Disinformation' in Crises (유사시 ‘허위정보’ 유포 차단…첫 한미 합동 도상훈련 실시)

As the importance of 'cognitive warfare'—spreading false information to disrupt an adversary's judgment and public sentiment, as seen in recent conflicts like the Ukraine war—draws attention, South Korea and the United States have recently conducted their first joint tabletop exercise (TTX) to counter such threats. (최근 우크라이나 전쟁 등에서 허위 정보를 퍼트려 상대국의 판단과 민심을 교란하는 ‘인지전’의 중요성이 주목받는 가운데, 최근 한미가 처음으로 이런 위협에 대응하는 연합 도상 훈련(TTX)을 실시했다.)

Cognitive warfare refers to a method of warfare that fosters false perceptions among an adversary's leadership or public to induce psychological turmoil or strategic errors. (인지전이란 상대 국가의 지도부나 대중에게 잘못된 인식을 조장해 심리적 동요나 전략적 실수를 유도하는 전쟁 수행 방식을 뜻한다.)

According to ROK-U.S. military authorities on the 12th, the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), U.S. Forces Korea (USFK), the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command, and the United Nations Command hosted a ROK-U.S. 'Interagency Strategic Communication Response Tabletop Exercise' at the JCS building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, on the 9th. (12일 한미 군 당국에 따르면 합동참모본부와 주한미군, 한미연합군사령부, 유엔군사령부는 지난 9일 서울 용산구 합참 청사에서 한미 ‘정부기관 연계 전략적 소통 대응 도상 훈련’을 주최했다.)

This exercise, organized under the leadership of the JCS, involved numerous domestic government agencies, including the Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Ministry of Science and ICT, Korea Communications Commission, National Intelligence Service, and National Police Agency. It was reported that each agency introduced its roles related to communication strategies in crisis situations and coordinated effective response measures. (합참 주도로 마련된 이번 훈련에는 국방부, 외교부, 문화체육관광부, 과학기술정보통신부, 방송미디어통신위원회, 국가정보원, 경찰청 등 국내 정부 기관도 다수 참여했다. 각 기관은 유사시 소통 전략 등과 관련해 각자가 하는 역할을 소개하고 효과적 대응 방안을 조율한 것으로 전해졌다.)

While coordination meetings among relevant agencies to counter wartime disinformation had been held before, this is understood to be the first time ROK-U.S. military authorities and related government agencies have gathered broadly for a tabletop exercise. (이전에도 전시 허위 정보에 대응하는 유관 기관 협조 회의 등은 개최된 적이 있지만, 한미 군 당국과 관련 정부 기관이 폭넓게 모여 도상훈련을 한 것은 이번이 처음으로 알려졌다.)

USFK explained that the exercise was held considering the critical role of the information environment in modern conflict, describing it in a press release as "the first comprehensive combined, interagency, and multinational exercise specifically focused on synchronizing operations within the information environment." (주한미군은 현대 분쟁에서 정보 환경이 지니는 중요한 역할을 고려해 이번 훈련이 개최됐다며 “정보 환경 내 작전의 동기화에 구체적으로 초점을 맞춘 최초의 종합적 연합·범정부·다국적 훈련”이라고 보도자료를 통해 설명했다.)

According to USFK, the tabletop exercise focused on discussions in areas including: ▲ Countering foreign disinformation ▲ Synchronizing responses to multi-domain threats such as cyber, space, and the electromagnetic spectrum ▲ Aligning strategic communication. (주한미군에 따르면 이번 도상훈련에서는 ▲ 해외 허위 정보(disinformation) 대응 ▲ 사이버·우주·전자기 스펙트럼 등 다영역 위협 대응 동기화 ▲ 전략적 소통 조율(alignment) 등 분야가 중점적으로 논의됐다.)

The decision by South Korea and the U.S. to hold such an event is interpreted as a response to the recent evolution of the battlefield, where cognitive warfare using non-physical means like social media has emerged as a critical factor. (한미가 이런 자리를 마련한 것은 최근 전장 환경 변화에 따라 소셜미디어 등 비물리적 수단을 무기로 한 인지전이 중요한 요소로 부상하고 있기 때문으로 해석된다.)

Military authorities are reported to be considering applying the discussions from this exercise to more specific scenarios during the upcoming ROK-U.S. joint exercise 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) next month. (군 당국은 이번에 논의한 내용을 다음 달 개최될 한미연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS·을지프리덤실드)에서 보다 구체적인 시나리오에 적용해 보는 방안도 검토하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: People Power Party Demands Dismissal of Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, Calling Him "The Mastermind Behind the 'Squid Game' Stock Market" (국힘, 김용범 정책실장 경질 요구 “‘오징어 게임’ 증시 주범”)
item.description:
People Power Party Demands Dismissal of Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, Calling Him "The Mastermind Behind the 'Squid Game' Stock Market" (국힘, 김용범 정책실장 경질 요구 “‘오징어 게임’ 증시 주범”)

The People Power Party (PPP) claimed that the responsibility for the extreme volatility in the domestic stock market lies with Kim Yong-beom, Cheong Wa Dae's chief of policy, who allowed financial companies to launch single-stock leveraged ETFs (exchange-traded funds). The party demanded that President Lee Jae-myung dismiss Kim. (국민의힘은 국내 주식시장의 변동성이 극심해진 책임이 금융회사들이 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF(상장 지수 펀드)를 출시하게 한 김용범 청와대 정책실장에게 있다고 주장하면서 이재명 대통령에게 김 실장을 경질하라고 요구했다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon said in a commentary on the 12th, "Last year, there were only nine days when the KOSPI surged or plunged by more than 3% in a single day, but this year, it has already reached 42 days." He pointed out, "In particular, since the launch of single-stock leveraged products, 16 out of 30 trading days have seen repeated spikes and crashes." <<> He added, "Program trading halts every four days, and the entire market freezes about once a month." He remarked, "A 'wag the dog' situation, where the tail of derivatives shakes the body of the stock market, has become routine." He criticized, "This isn't a normal investment market; it's a 'Squid Game' stock market where only those who survive to the end can make money." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi claimed, "At the starting point of this disastrous situation is Director Kim." He noted, "After holding a private meeting with heads of securities and asset management firms in January, Kim himself revealed that he had raised the issue (of launching single-stock leveraged ETFs) with the Financial Services Commission (FSC) and ordered a review." He pointed out, "And in less than five months, single-stock leveraged ETFs, which previously had no legal basis, were launched. The FSC hastily revised the enforcement decree and regulations, and even industry insiders called it 'unprecedentedly fast.'" <<> He continued, "While there were concerns within financial authorities about increased volatility and market distortion, there are testimonies that they couldn't defy the overwhelming directives from the policy office." He added, "Eventually, all 14 launched products were concentrated on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and a vicious cycle began where the fluctuations of these two stocks, through mechanical trading, shook the entire market." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi criticized, "Despite the situation reaching this point, Director Kim, who led the policy, is merely saying, 'If supplementation is needed, it will be decided at the market situation review meeting,' passing the buck to the ministries as if it's someone else's business, without a single word of regret." Choi asked Kim, "Where has the confidence gone, with which you previously dismissed the 'three highs' as the cost of success with constant interference? Are you now hiding like a ghost in the face of the trouble you caused?" He also said, "How else would the head of the Financial Supervisory Service have bowed his head, saying, 'I should have stopped (the launch of single-stock leveraged ETFs) even if it meant lying down on the job?'" He added, "The policy office pushed it through, and the financial authorities caved—this is the reality of Cheong Wa Dae-led government-directed finance, and the main culprit behind retail investors shedding tears of blood." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi also criticized Kim's policies on real estate and exchange rates, saying, "With a robbing-Peter-to-pay-Paul loan policy, he kicked away the housing ladder by driving the average price of apartments in Seoul to 1.59 billion won, and his remarks tolerating a high exchange rate have cemented the era of 1,500 won per dollar." <<> He further criticized, "He stirs up every market and amplifies chaos, but now that public opinion has worsened, he belatedly says, 'The government doesn't have all the answers,' and plans to hold a forum to adjust the intensity." He denounced this as "a typical diversion tactic to shift the blame for policy failures onto the people and the field." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi pressed, "What did Director Kim discuss in that private meeting (with heads of securities and asset management firms last January)? Why did he ignore internal opposition and warnings? Why did he rush to open the door for a system that concentrated leveraged products only on the top two stocks by market capitalization?" He asserted, "This dangerous policy experiment, conducted with the people's assets as collateral, cannot be dismissed as a misjudgment or a supplemental task for ministries." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi urged, "The price for turning the market into a gambling den and making the people shed tears of blood will not be light. Director Kim must apologize directly to the people right now, and President Lee Jae-myung should immediately dismiss Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, holding him heavily accountable for the catastrophic failure his hasty policy has caused." (국민의힘 최보윤 수석대변인은 12일 논평을 통해 “지난해 코스피가 하루 3% 이상 급등락한 날은 9일뿐이었지만, 올해는 벌써 42일에 달한다”며 “특히 단일 종목 레버리지 상품 출시 이후 30거래일 중 16일이나 폭등과 폭락이 반복됐다”고 짚었다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil Begins ‘Honam Sojourn’ for a Month… “I Will Find Answers on the Ground in Honam” (송영길, 한달간 ‘호남살이’ 시작…“호남 현장에서 답 찾겠다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil Begins ‘Honam Sojourn’ for a Month… “I Will Find Answers on the Ground in Honam” (송영길, 한달간 ‘호남살이’ 시작…“호남 현장에서 답 찾겠다”)

Song Young-gil, a lawmaker challenging for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 12th that he will begin a month-long stay in Honam starting today until the end of the party convention on the 17th of next month. (더불어민주당 당권에 도전한 송영길 의원이 전당대회가 끝나는 다음달 17일까지 한달간 호남살이에 돌입한다고 12일 밝혔다.)

Song’s camp said on the same day, “From right after the party convention candidate registration on the 17th until August 17th, when the convention ends, we have decided to reside in Honam, including Gwangju, South Jeolla, and North Jeolla.” (송 의원 측은 이날 “오는 17일 민주당 전당대회 후보등록 직후 부터 전당대회가 끝나는 8.17일까지 광주, 전남,전북 등 호남에 상주하기로 했다”고 했다.)

Explaining the choice of Honam, Song stated, “The first shovel for President Lee Jae-myung’s decisive 800 trillion won semiconductor cluster is being placed in Honam. I decided to find answers at the site of this national project that carries the fate of South Korea, and I will demonstrate a ‘Song Young-gil-style’ approach on the ground.” (호남을 선택한 이유로 “지금 호남에는 이재명 대통령이 결단한 800조 원 반도체 클러스터의 첫 삽이 놓이고 있다”며 “대한민국의 명운이 걸린 국가 프로젝트 현장에서 답을 찾기로 했고, 현장에서 ‘송영길스러움’을 보여드리게될 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Also, referencing the success of the Honam semiconductor cluster, he said, “I am the only candidate among those in the party convention who has served as the head of a metropolitan government. I possess the experience of being the most senior lawmaker in the National Assembly (six terms) and diplomatic capabilities speaking four languages.” He added, “Lawmaker Song, who has dealt with global companies and investments, will find solid success strategies for the semiconductor cluster through his expertise.” (또 호남 반도체 클러스터 성공을 언급하며 “전대 후보중 유일하게 광역단체장을 지냈다”며 “국회 최다선 의원(6선)의 경륜, 4개국어를 구사하는 외교 역량을 갖췄다”고 했다. 그러면서 “글로벌 기업과 투자를 상대해 본 송 의원이 실력으로, 반도체 클러스터의 단단한 성공 방안을 찾아낼 것”이라고 했다.)

Afterwards, Song plans to personally inspect sites such as the military airfield site and Haenam Solar City, and meet with businesses, local governments, universities, and residents to check bottlenecks in water, electricity, land, and manpower one by one. (이후 송 의원은 군공항 부지·해남 솔라시도 등 현장을 직접 점검하고, 기업·지자체·대학·주민을 만나 용수·전력·부지·인력의 병목을 하나하나 확인할 계획이다.)

Furthermore, Song’s camp targeted former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, saying, “How will you protect the president if you fail in local elections and then general elections? Lawmaker Song Young-gil is a ‘sure-win maker.’ He is not a ‘pace maker.’” (또 송 의원 측은 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥해 “지방선거에 이어 총선도 실패하면 어떻게 대통령을 지키겠나”라며 “송영길 의원은 ‘필승 메이커’입니다. ‘페이스 메이커’가 아니다”라고도 했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Goodbye to Stagnation Theory... Korea's Economy Redrawing Its Long-Term Trend Line" (김용범 “바이바이 정체론... 한국 경제, 장기 추세선 다시 그리고 있다”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "Goodbye to Stagnation Theory... Korea's Economy Redrawing Its Long-Term Trend Line" (김용범 “바이바이 정체론... 한국 경제, 장기 추세선 다시 그리고 있다”)

Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office for Policy, stated on the 12th, "South Korea is no longer on its past trend line," adding, "The market is redrawing the long-term trend line for Korea's economy." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 12일 “한국은 더 이상 과거의 추세선 위에 있지 않다”며 “시장은 한국 경제의 장기 추세선을 다시 그리고 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim made this remark in a Facebook post titled "Goodbye to East Asian Stagnation Theory." He argued that the AI production revolution, the semiconductor supercycle, and government-led capital market reforms could propel South Korea's economy into a long-term growth trajectory. (김 실장은 이날 페이스북에 ‘바이바이 동아시아 정체론’이라는 제목의 글을 올리며 이같이 밝혔다. 인공지능(AI) 생산혁명과 반도체 슈퍼사이클, 정부 주도의 자본시장 개혁을 계기로 한국 경제가 장기 성장 추세로 돌입할 수 있다는 것이다.)

Chief Kim assessed the period of 2022–2024 under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration as "bleak" and "closer to decline than growth." He noted, "The semiconductor downcycle suppressed exports, and the KOSPI's correlation with the U.S. stock market broke down, leading to prolonged sluggishness," adding, "The Legoland incident triggered real estate PF risks, and political turmoil compounded the situation by late 2024." (김 실장은 윤석열 정부 때인 2022~2024년은 “암울했다” “성장보다 쇠퇴에 가까웠다”고 평가했다. 그는 “반도체 다운사이클이 수출을 짓눌렀고, 코스피는 미국 증시와의 동조 흐름이 깨지며 장기간 부진했다”며 “레고랜드 사태로 부동산 PF 리스크가 불거졌고, 2024년 말에는 정치적 혼란까지 겹쳤다”고 했다.)

However, he claimed that the atmosphere changed starting in the second half of 2025, when the Lee Jae-myung administration took office. He said, "As political uncertainty was resolved and policy directions were clarified, memory demand, data center investments, advanced packaging, and power infrastructure expansion all aligned simultaneously, rapidly reviving exports and corporate profits," and "the trend line began to shift direction." (그런데 이재명 정부가 들어선 2025년 하반기부터 분위기가 달라졌다고 주장했다. 그는 “정치적 불확실성이 수습되고 정책 방향이 정리되던 그 시점에 메모리 수요, 데이터센터 투자, 첨단 패키징, 전력 인프라 확대가 한꺼번에 맞물리며 수출과 기업이익이 빠르게 살아났다”며 “추세선이 방향을 바꾸기 시작했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Growth forecasts were revised upward consecutively, and South Korea began to be reassessed as the country expected to achieve the highest growth rate among advanced nations in 2026–2027," adding, "It's hard to see this as a mere rebound. The market is redrawing Korea's long-term trend line." (이어 “성장률 전망은 연이어 상향됐고, 한국은 2026~2027년 선진국 가운데 가장 높은 성장률이 예상되는 국가로 재평가되기 시작했다”며 “이것을 단순한 반등으로만 보기는 어렵다. 시장은 한국 경제의 장기 추세선을 다시 그리고 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim stated, "The magnitude of upward growth adjustments, the speed of capital market reassessment, and the intensity of policy and industrial cycles aligning are at levels rarely seen in Korea's economy in recent decades," explaining, "This is why the changes now occurring should be viewed not as a simple economic recovery, but as an initial phase showing the potential for a shift in the long-term trend itself." (김 실장은 “성장률 전망의 상향폭, 자본시장 재평가의 속도, 정책과 산업 사이클이 맞물린 강도는 최근 수십 년 한국 경제에서 쉽게 찾아보기 어려운 수준”이라며 “지금 나타나는 변화를 단순한 경기 회복이 아니라 장기 추세 자체가 달라질 가능성을 보여주는 초기 국면으로 읽어야 하는 이유”라고 했다.)

Chief Kim remarked, "Explaining this turnaround solely by semiconductors would miss the most important part," citing the government's announced 'Three Major Mega Projects,' amendments to the Commercial Act, treasury stock system reforms, and the National Growth Fund. He added, "If the AI production revolution and capital market reforms work together, key supply chain nodes become new sources of growth, and the three mega projects boost production capacity itself, South Korea could go from being the country that most faithfully followed Japan's path to the one that first breaks away from it." (김 실장은 “이번 반전을 반도체 하나로만 설명하면 가장 중요한 부분을 놓친다”며 정부가 발표한 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’와 상법 개정, 자사주 제도 개편, 국민성장펀드 등의 정책을 거론했다. 그러면서 “AI 생산혁명과 자본시장 개혁이 함께 작동하고, 공급망의 핵심 노드가 새로운 성장의 원천이 되며, 3대 메가 프로젝트가 생산능력 자체를 다시 끌어올린다면 한국은 일본의 길을 가장 충실히 따라온 나라에서, 그 길을 가장 먼저 벗어나는 나라가 될 수도 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim also posted on Facebook the previous day, saying, "Semiconductor fabs are not just production facilities but hubs where national industrial capabilities are built," and "The state has a responsibility to establish the industrial foundation for (corporate) competitiveness to be realized." He emphasized the need for a national-level speed strategy, stating, "Removing bottlenecks in power, water, transmission networks, permits, and industrial infrastructure so that companies can secure production capacity as quickly as possible—that is the role only the state can play." (김 실장은 전날에도 페이스북에 “반도체 팹은 생산시설인 동시에 국가 산업 역량이 쌓이는 거점”이라며 “국가는 (기업의) 경쟁력이 발휘될 수 있는 산업 기반을 구축할 책임이 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “기업이 가장 빠르게 생산능력을 확보할 수 있도록 전력과 용수, 송전망과 인허가, 산업 인프라의 병목을 제거하는 것, 그것이 국가만이 할 수 있는 역할”이라며 국가 차원의 속도전 필요성을 거듭 강조했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Election Commission spent billions of won annually without budget or settlement ([단독] 선관위, 예·결산도 없이 연 수백억원 마음대로 썼다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Election Commission spent billions of won annually without budget or settlement ([단독] 선관위, 예·결산도 없이 연 수백억원 마음대로 썼다)

The National Election Commission (NEC) has been spending hundreds of millions to billions of won annually without legal grounds, using money not recorded in the national budget or settlement, until it faced a corrective request from the National Assembly. (선거관리위원회가 국가의 예산·결산에 잡히지 않는 돈을 매년 수억~수백억원씩 법적 근거도 없이 집행해 오다가 국회의 시정 요구를 받았다.)

According to the 2025 fiscal year settlement analysis report released by the National Assembly Budget Office (NABO) on the 10th, the NEC has been managing elections for public organizations upon their request, as stipulated by laws such as the Consignment Election Act. These elections include those for the heads and presidents of central associations and cooperatives like Nonghyup, Suhyup, Forestry Cooperatives, and Credit Unions, as well as university president elections and elections for the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee and local sports councils. (국회예산정책처(예정처)가 지난 10일 공개한 2025회계연도 결산 분석 보고서에 따르면, 선관위는 위탁선거법 등 법령에 따라 공공 단체의 위탁을 받아 해당 단체의 선거를 관리해 왔다. 농협·수협·산림조합·신협의 중앙회장 및 조합장 선거, 대학 총장 선거, 대한체육회·지방체육회 선거 등이 선관위의 위탁 관리를 받는다.)

However, the NEC has not included most of the money it receives and spends for these "consignment elections" in its own budget or settlement. Last year, the cost incurred by the NEC for managing 1,190 consigned elections was a mere 128 million won in its settlement. This amounts to about 107,600 won per election. Yet, the NABO confirmed that the NEC actually spent 22.439 billion won on managing these elections for various public organizations last year. Only 0.57% of the actual spending was recorded in the "NEC's ledger." The NABO stated that 22.311 billion won in 2025, 700 million won in 2024, 34.002 billion won in 2023, 2.387 billion won in 2022, and 908 million won in 2021 were executed without being included in the NEC's budget or settlement. (그런데 선관위는 이런 ‘위탁 선거’를 해주고 받은 돈과 쓴 돈 대부분을 선관위 예산·결산에 포함시키지 않고 있다. 지난해 선관위가 각종 선거 1190건을 위탁받아 관리해주는 데 들인 비용은 선관위 결산상으로는 단 1억2800만원에 불과했다. 선거 1건당 약 10만7600원을 썼다는 것이다. 그러나 예정처가 확인해 보니, 선관위가 지난해 각종 공공 단체의 선거를 위탁받아 관리해주는 데 실제로 쓴 돈은 224억3900만원에 달했다. 선관위가 실제로 쓴 돈의 0.57%만이 ‘선관위 가계부’에 적힌 것이다. 예정처는 지난해 223억1100만원, 2024년 7억원, 2023년 340억200만원, 2022년 23억8700만원, 2021년 9억800만원이 선관위 예산·결산에 포함되지 않은 채로 집행됐다고 밝혔다.)

It is a fundamental principle that all revenue and expenditure collected or earned by state agencies, including the NEC, must be included in the budget and settlement. This allows for oversight and control by the National Assembly and the Board of Audit and Inspection. Maintaining a separate "pocket" outside of revenue and expenditure is only permitted in extremely exceptional cases, such as "excess expenditure over revenue-substituting expenses," "in-kind contributions," or "on-lending." Yet, the NEC has been operating hundreds of billions of won in consignment election expenses without any legal basis and free from any oversight. (선관위를 비롯한 국가 기관이 걷거나 벌어들인 돈(세입)과 쓴 돈(세출)은 모두 예산·결산에 포함돼야 하는 것이 기본 원칙이다. 그래야 국회와 감사원으로부터 예산·결산에 대한 통제와 감시를 받기 때문이다. 세입·세출 외로 ‘딴 주머니’를 차는 것은 ‘수입 대체 경비 초과 지출’ ‘현물 출자’ ‘전대차관’ 등 극히 예외적인 경우에만 허용된다. 그런데 선관위만 법령상 근거도 없이 위탁 선거 관련 경비 수백억원을 누구의 통제도 받지 않고 운영해온 것이다.)

The NABO pointed out that "because consignment election expenses are operated outside the revenue and expenditure budget, they are excluded from the National Assembly's budget and settlement review." It added, "Although the Consignment Election Act was amended on August 14, 2025, requiring the NEC to submit settlement reports for consignment election expenses to the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee, this still falls short of the transparency level of the revenue and expenditure budget disclosed to the general public." In fact, detailed breakdowns of the money spent by the NEC for consignment election expenses are not disclosed to the public. (예정처는 “위탁 선거 경비가 세입·세출 예산 외로 운영되다 보니, 국회의 예결산 심사 대상에서 벗어나 있다”고 지적했다. 또 “2025년 8월 14일 위탁선거법이 개정돼 (선관위가) 국회 행정안전위원회에 위탁 선거 경비 결산서 등을 제출하고는 있으나, 일반 국민에게 공개되는 세입·세출 예산 수준의 투명성에는 미치지 못한다”고 했다. 실제로 선관위가 위탁 선거 경비 명목으로 쓴 돈의 세부 내역은 일반 국민에게 공개되지 않고 있다.)

Cases have already been uncovered within the NEC where consignment election expenses were used carelessly, as if they were unaccounted money. According to the NABO, the Chungbuk Provincial Election Commission executed over 23 billion won in consignment election expenses without proper reporting or approval procedures, which was discovered during an audit by the National Election Commission last year. There were also over 480 instances of officials falsifying or forging payment resolution documents. Monthly settlements or accounting document arrangements were either not done on time or were entirely skipped. (이미 선관위 내에서는 위탁 선거 경비를 눈먼 돈처럼 쓴 사례가 적발되고 있다. 예정처에 따르면, 충북선관위는 위탁 선거 경비를 정당한 보고나 결재 절차 없이 230억원 넘게 집행했다가 지난해 중앙선관위 감사에 적발됐다. 담당자가 지급 결의서를 변조하거나 허위로 작성한 경우도 480여 차례 있었다. 월말 결산이나 회계 서류 정리도 제때 하지 않았고, 아예 건너뛴 경우도 있었다.)

The NEC first receives a lump sum for consignment election expenses from the public organizations that entrust election management to it, then uses the funds arbitrarily and returns the remainder. This creates a structure where it is difficult for outsiders to detect or prevent the NEC from retaining a portion of the expenses as profit or diverting funds elsewhere. While the NEC reported spending 22.311 billion won on consignment election expenses outside its revenue and expenditure last year, it actually received 38.835 billion won from public organizations and returned 16.524 billion won. It is unclear whether the full 22.311 billion won was genuinely used for consignment election management. (선관위는 위탁 선거 경비를 선관위에 선거 관리를 위탁하는 공공 단체로부터 먼저 총액으로 받은 뒤, 이를 임의로 사용하고 남은 돈을 돌려주고 있다. 선관위가 경비 일부를 수익처럼 남기거나 다른 곳으로 빼돌려 쓰더라도 이를 외부에서 알고 막기가 어려운 구조다. 선관위는 지난해 세입·세출 외 위탁 선거 경비로 223억1100만원을 쓴 것으로 돼 있지만, 실제로 공공 단체로부터 받은 경비는 388억3500만원이었고, 돌려준 금액은 165억2400만원이었다. 223억1100만원이 온전히 위탁 선거 관리에 쓰였는지는 알 수 없다.)

The NEC has argued that operating consignment election expenses outside the revenue and expenditure budget, as currently done, is "inevitable," citing reasons such as "the difficulty of determining the budget size during the budget formulation and review stages due to the nature of consignment elections" and "issues with carrying over expenses when an election spans two years." A bill has even been proposed in the National Assembly to legalize the NEC's practice of excluding consignment election expenses from the budget and settlement. (선관위는 “위탁 선거의 특성상 예산안 편성·심의 단계에서 예산 규모를 확정하기가 어렵다” “선거 기간이 두 해에 걸쳐 있는 경우 경비를 이월 처리해야 하는 문제가 있다” 등의 이유를 들어 지금처럼 위탁 선거 경비를 세입·세출에 포함시키지 않은 채로 운영하는 것이 “불가피하다”고 주장했다고 한다. 국회에는 선관위가 위탁 선거 경비를 예산·결산에 포함시키지 않는 것을 합법화해주자는 법안도 발의돼 있다.)

However, the NABO rejected the NEC's arguments, stating, "The claim that it is difficult to formulate a budget due to low predictability is unpersuasive. For expenses spanning two years, the budget can be formulated over two years or systems like carryover can be utilized, just as with other expenses." (그러나 예정처는 “예측 가능성이 낮다는 이유로 예산을 편성하는 것이 어렵다는 주장은 설득력이 낮고, 선거가 두 해에 걸쳐 있는 경비의 경우 다른 경비와 마찬가지로 예산을 두 해에 걸쳐 편성하거나 (첫 해에 쓰고 남은 예산을 이듬해로) 이월시키는 제도를 활용할 수 있다”며 선관위의 주장을 받아들이지 않았다.)

The NABO pointed out to the NEC that "to ensure fiscal transparency and accountability, and to contribute to strengthening the National Assembly's fiscal control authority on behalf of the people, consignment election expenses should be included in the national finances and operated under items such as 'revenue-substituting expenses.'" (예정처는 선관위에 “위탁 선거 경비를 국가 재정에 포함되도록 ‘수입 대체 경비’ 등의 항목으로 운용해야 재정의 투명성과 책임성을 확보하고 국민을 대표하는 국회의 재정 통제 권한 강화에 기여할 수 있을 것”이라고 지적했다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigative Powers Is Unconstitutional" (이석연 “검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 위헌”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigative Powers Is Unconstitutional" (이석연 “검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 위헌”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chief of the presidential committee on national unity, said on the 12th that “the complete abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers is unconstitutional.” This is because the complete abolition of these powers, pursued by the Democratic Party of Korea, fundamentally denies the ‘prosecutors’ investigative authority’ as stipulated by the Constitution. (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장은 12일 “검사의 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 헌법에 위배된다”고 했다. 더불어민주당이 추진하는 검사의 보완 수사권 완전 폐지가, 헌법이 규정한 ‘검사의 수사권’을 전면 부정하고 있어서 위헌이라는 것이다.)

In a statement issued that day, Chairman Lee stated, “Although the Constitution does not prevent the abolition of the prosecution office itself to disperse prosecutors’ powers, entirely stripping prosecutors of their investigative authority as the primary investigative body goes against the principle of constitutional systemic legitimacy and has elements of unconstitutionality.” (이 위원장은 이날 입장문을 통해 “헌법은 비록 검찰청을 폐지하여 검사의 권한을 분산하는 것까지는 막고 있지 않지만, 수사의 주체로서의 검사가 가진 수사권의 완전 박탈은 헌법의 체계 정당성의 원리에 반하여 위헌의 소지가 있다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee pointed out that the current Constitution (Article 12, Paragraph 3; Article 16) designates the application for warrants necessary for arrest, detention, seizure, and search as the exclusive and sole authority of prosecutors. He argued, “To completely abolish prosecutors’ investigative powers, the Constitution must be amended to change the warrant application authority, as in the first Constitution, from prosecutors to investigative agencies, or it must be delegated to law.” The complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers, he noted, amounts to denying the investigative authority of prosecutors, who are the subjects of warrant applications, making it unconstitutional. (이 위원장은 현행 헌법(12조 3항, 16조)이 체포·구속·압수·수색 등에 필요한 영장의 신청을 검사의 독점적·배타적 권한으로 규정하고 있다는 점을 지적하며 “검사의 수사권을 완전 박탈하기 위해서는 헌법을 개정하여 영장신청권을 제헌헌법처럼 검사 대신 수사기관으로 고치든지 아니면 법률에 위임해야 한다”고 했다. 보완수사권의 완전 폐지는, 영장 신청의 주체인 검사의 수사권을 인정하지 않는 것이기 때문에 위헌이라는 것이다.)

Chairman Lee stated, “Not only for the protection of victims, the discovery of substantive truth, and the swift realization of justice in criminal law, but also to uphold the spirit of the Constitution, prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers must be recognized in some form.” He then directly criticized the Democratic Party, adding, “Responsible political parties should not abandon the basic principles for the future of the community in the name of reform, clinging to the immediate approval of their support base or party interests.” (이 위원장은 “피해자 보호, 실체적 진실 발견, 형사 사법의 신속한 정의 실현이라는 차원에서 뿐만 아니라 헌법의 정신을 지키기 위해서도 검사의 보완 수사권은 어떤 형태로든지 인정되어야 한다고 본다”고 했다. 이어 “책임 있는 공당이라면 당장의 지지층의 눈치나 당리당략에 매달려 개혁이라는 이름으로 공동체의 미래를 위한 기본 원칙을 저버려서는 아니된다”고 민주당을 직격했다.)

Chairman Lee also said, “The system itself has no inherent good or evil,” and “regardless of the system, it’s a matter of the people who operate it.” He added, “The issue of prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers should also be discussed in that context.” (이 위원장은 “제도 그 자체는 선악이 없다”며 “어떤 제도가 됐든 그 제도를 운영하는 사람의 문제”라고도 했다. 그러면서 “검사의 보완 수사권 문제도 그런 차원에서 논의되어야 한다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee expressed, “Furthermore, I earnestly hope that the pressing issues of our society, which are heading toward severe national division, will be discussed and resolved based on legal stability and predictability, in accordance with the Constitution and sound public common sense.” He concluded, “This is the way to realize the political justice pursued by the Constitution and the path to achieving social integration.” (이 위원장은 “나아가 심각한 국론 분열로 치닫고 있는 우리 사회의 현안들이 법적 안정성과 예측 가능성을 바탕으로 헌법과 건전한 국민 상식에 따라 논의되고 해결되기를 간절히 기대한다”며 “그것이 헌법이 추구하는 정치적 정의를 실현하는 길이자 사회 통합을 이루는 길”이라고 했다.)

Chairman Lee is a centrist conservative figure who served as the Minister of Government Legislation during the Lee Myung-bak administration. President Lee Jae-myung recruited him during the last presidential election and appointed him as a co-chair of the joint election committee. After the government was launched, he was selected as the chief of the presidential committee on national unity. (이 위원장은 이명박 정부에서 법제처장을 지낸 중도 보수 인사다. 이재명 대통령은 지난 대선 때 이 위원장을 영입해 공동선거대책위원장에 임명했다. 정부 출범 뒤 국민통합위원장에 발탁됐다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Jang Yoon-ki’s father, who said he was “just tidying up,” destroyed evidence while cycling through annual leave and sick leave ([단독] “짐정리”라던 장윤기父, 연가·병가 돌려써가며 증거인멸)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Jang Yoon-ki’s father, who said he was “just tidying up,” destroyed evidence while cycling through annual leave and sick leave ([단독] “짐정리”라던 장윤기父, 연가·병가 돌려써가며 증거인멸)

It was confirmed on the 12th that Superintendent Jang (55), the father of Jang Yoon-ki (23, in custody), a suspect in the "Gwangju, Jeonnam high school girl murder case," used alternating annual leave, sick leave, and official leave after the crime to destroy key evidence. <<> According to work records submitted by the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Shin Dong-wook, Superintendent Jang took six hours of "emergency annual leave" on May 5, the day of his son Jang Yoon-ki's crime and arrest. Records show that Superintendent Jang retroactively applied for annual leave in the internal system around 1:13 PM the following day, May 6. <<> Subsequently, Superintendent Jang took sick leave from May 8 to 18. It was investigated that during this period, key evidence proving Jang Yoon-ki's charge of rape and murder was damaged or concealed by Superintendent Jang. <<> According to investigations by the prosecution and police, the investigation team from the Gwangju Gwangsan Police Station, which handled the case, discovered a damaged sex doll (adult doll) in Jang Yoon-ki's studio apartment on May 5 but did not seize it. The following day, May 6, they handed over Jang Yoon-ki's SUV, which contained 50-centimeter-long industrial cable ties, to his father, Superintendent Jang. <<> Furthermore, on May 7, the investigation team shared the password to Jang Yoon-ki's studio apartment with Superintendent Jang. On May 8, Superintendent Jang took sick leave, entered his son's studio apartment, cut two sex dolls—key evidence of rape and murder—into pieces, and discarded them at various locations across Gwangju and Jeonnam. <<> On the same day, it was reported that Superintendent Jang asked Superintendent Park (59, in custody), the head of the investigation team, during a phone call, "Is the place where Jang Yoon-ki threw away his usual cell phone under the Yeongsan River High-tech Bridge?" After Superintendent Park confirmed "Yes," Superintendent Jang personally searched around the High-tech Bridge. The cell phone thrown away by Jang Yoon-ki has not been found to date. Superintendent Jang also gathered and burned several old cell phones that Jang Yoon-ki used at home before moving out in 2024. <<> On July 7, during a search and seizure of Superintendent Jang's home, the prosecution discovered cable ties, another piece of evidence in the rape and murder case. The prosecution suspects that Superintendent Jang, after receiving Jang Yoon-ki's vehicle from the Gwangsan Police Station investigation team, concealed evidence. <<> It was also revealed that during the evidence destruction process, Superintendent Jang personally deleted dozens of phone call recording files with investigation team members and even turned off the "auto-record function" on his smartphone. However, during the investigation by the police's special investigation team, Superintendent Jang reportedly denied the intent to destroy evidence, claiming, "I was just trying to tidy up." Regarding the disposal of the sex dolls, Superintendent Jang is said to have stated, "Now I understand that they were important evidence, but at the time in May, since the police gave me the address and password of the apartment, I thought it was okay to get rid of them." <<> Superintendent Jang was not formally charged under the criminal law's "special exemption clause for relatives," which exempts acts that conceal crimes of family members from punishment. However, the National Police Agency stated, "Even if Superintendent Jang is excluded from criminal punishment, disciplinary action will be taken based on the results of the internal affairs investigation." After his sick leave ended on May 18, Superintendent Jang has been using "a rotating approach" with long-term service leave (May 19 to June 2), annual leave (June 3 to 30), official leave (July 2), and annual leave (July 3 to 14). <<> Lawmaker Shin Dong-wook of the People Power Party said, "Superintendent Jang, a key figure in the case, has not even been formally charged due to the special exemption for relatives," and added, "A revision to the criminal law to exclude police officers from the special exemption for relatives is necessary." (‘전남광주 여고생 피살 사건’ 피의자 장윤기(23·구속)의 부친인 장모(55) 경감이 범행 이후 연가·병가·공가 등을 돌려쓰면서 핵심 증거 인멸에 나선 것으로 12일 확인됐다.)

item.title: One Navy Soldier Missing in East Sea… Possible Drift North of NLL, Request for Search Cooperation Sent to North Korea (동해상 해군 1명 실종… NLL 북쪽 표류 가능성, 北에 수색 협조 요청)
item.description:
One Navy Soldier Missing in East Sea… Possible Drift North of NLL, Request for Search Cooperation Sent to North Korea (동해상 해군 1명 실종… NLL 북쪽 표류 가능성, 北에 수색 협조 요청)

A soldier from a Navy frigate on patrol duty in the northern East Sea went missing on the 12th, and military authorities are conducting a search. The Navy reportedly notified North Korea of the disappearance through the International Maritime Common Network, which North Korea can also receive, in preparation for the possibility that the soldier may have drifted north of the Northern Limit Line (NLL). (동해 북단 해상에서 경비 임무 중이던 해군 호위함의 병사 1명이 12일 실종돼 군 당국이 수색 중이다. 해군은 북방한계선(NLL) 이북 지역으로 이 병사가 표류했을 가능성에 대비해 북한도 수신이 가능한 국제상선공통망을 통해 실종 사실을 북측에도 통지한 것으로 알려졌다.)

The Navy stated on the same day, "A crew member (private first class) from a Navy vessel on patrol duty in the waters approximately 50 kilometers east of Geojin-eup, Goseong-gun, in the East Sea, went missing this morning." The soldier was last seen in an indoor passageway of the vessel between midnight and 2 a.m. by a duty officer conducting internal patrols but failed to report for duty at 8 a.m., leading to the discovery of his disappearance. (해군은 이날 “오늘 오전 동해 고성군 거진읍 동방 50여㎞ 해상에서 경비 임무 수행 중인 해군 함정 승조원(일병) 1명이 실종됐다”고 밝혔다. 이 병사는 이날 오전 0∼2시 사이 함 내부 순찰을 맡았던 당직자에 의해 함정 실내 통로에서 마지막으로 목격됐지만, 오전 8시 당직 근무에 나오지 않으면서 실종 사실이 인지된 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Navy, in coordination with the Coast Guard, is deploying around 10 vessels and multiple aircraft to search for the missing individual. The Navy also stated, "We are disseminating the situation to fishing boats and nearby merchant vessels and requesting their cooperation in the search." Notably, the disappearance was reported to North Korea via the International Maritime Common Network, a radio channel used by multinational ships and coastal stations on a shared frequency in international waters. The Ministry of National Defense confirmed that Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek was informed of the missing person and ordered "active cooperation with relevant agencies such as the Coast Guard" for a swift rescue. (해군은 해경과 합동으로 함정 10여 척과 항공기 여러 대를 투입해 실종자를 탐색 중이다. 해군은 또 “조업 중인 어선, 인근 상선 등에도 상황을 전파하고 수색을 협조하고 있다”고 밝혔다. 특히 공해상에서 다국적 선박과 해안 기지국들이 공용 주파수를 통해 교신하는 무선 채널인 국제상선공통망을 통해 북한에도 실종자 발생을 알렸다. 안규백 국방부 장관은 실종 보고를 받고 “해경 등 유관 기관과도 적극적인 공조 체계를 유지하라”며 신속한 구조를 지시했다고 국방부가 밝혔다.)

In related news, the Ministry of Unification announced in an afternoon press release, "It appears possible that the missing soldier may have drifted north of the NLL," and "We have requested cooperation from (North Korea) in the search and repatriation of the missing person from a humanitarian perspective." North Korea has unilaterally severed all military communication lines and the inter-Korean joint liaison office communication lines since April 2023. A Ministry of Unification official said, "As direct communication is not possible, we used an indirect notification method." In October 2023, the South Korean Navy discovered a drifting North Korean vessel near the NLL and notified North Korea through 'media reports.' (이와 관련, 통일부는 이날 오후 “실종된 병사가 NLL 이북 지역으로 표류 가능성이 있는 것으로 보인다”며 “(북한이) 인도주의적 견지에서 실종자 수색과 송환에 협조해주기를 요청했다”고 언론 공지를 통해 밝혔다. 북한은 2023년 4월 이후 군 통신선과 남북공동연락사무소 통신선을 모두 일방 차단했다. 통일부 당국자는 “직접 소통이 안 되는 상황인 만큼 간접 통보 방식을 사용한 것”이라고 했다. 2023년 10월에도 NLL 인근에서 표류하던 북한 선박을 우리 해군이 발견하고 ‘언론 보도’를 통해 북측에 관련 사실을 통보한 적이 있다.)

However, there are criticisms within the military about whether the Ministry of Unification's press release was necessary after the Navy had already notified North Korea via the International Maritime Common Network. A military source commented, "There are complaints that the Ministry of Unification acts as if it's working through the media, even though it can't do anything effectively." (다만 군에서는 국제상선공통망으로 북한에 실종 사실을 알린 상태에서 통일부의 언론 공지가 필요했느냐는 지적도 나온다. 군 관계자는 “통일부가 실효적으로 할 수 있는 일은 아무것도 없으면서 언론을 통해 일하는 척만 한다는 불만이 나온다”고 전했다.)

item.title: Gwangju Air Base Conducts 8,800 Training Flights Annually... No Immediate Alternative Site for Relocation (광주 군공항 年 8800회 훈련… 당장 옮겨갈 곳이 없다)
item.description:
Gwangju Air Base Conducts 8,800 Training Flights Annually... No Immediate Alternative Site for Relocation (광주 군공항 年 8800회 훈련… 당장 옮겨갈 곳이 없다)

The presidential office's proposal to accelerate the creation of a Honam semiconductor cluster by first dispersing military aircraft from Gwangju Air Base to other air force bases has drawn criticism from military circles, with some calling it "a forced plan requiring significant time and cost." Not only is it expected to take at least a year and a half to relocate the specialized pilot training facilities of Gwangju Air Base, but repeated temporary dispersals and relocations could also negatively impact training continuity. (청와대가 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성을 앞당기기 위해 광주 군공항에 있는 군용기를 우선 다른 공군 기지로 분산 배치할 수 있다는 구상을 밝히자, 군 안팎에서 “많은 시간과 비용이 들어가는 무리한 방안”이라는 지적이 나오고 있다. 조종사 훈련에 특화된 광주 군공항의 주요 시설을 이전하는 데 최소 1년 반 이상 걸릴 것으로 예상될 뿐더러, 임시 분산과 이전을 반복하면 훈련 지속성에도 부정적 영향을 줄 수 있다는 것이다.)

During a YTN radio interview on the 6th, Cheong Wa Dae policy chief Kim Yong-beom stated regarding the relocation of Gwangju Air Base, "Since building an air base takes an absolute amount of time, if we wait until then, can we disperse the training requirements and such from the current base to other air force bases?" He added, "If we work out a dispersal plan with the air force, we can use this site without waiting for a new airport to be built in Muan." The gist was that by first dispersing the equipment and facilities of Gwangju Air Base to other air force bases, semiconductor cluster construction could begin before the completion of a replacement airport in Muan, South Jeolla Province. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 지난 6일 YTN 라디오 인터뷰에서 광주 군공항 이전과 관련해 “군공항을 짓는 데는 절대적 시간이 있으니까, 그때까지 하자고 하면 지금 있는 공항에서 하고 있는 훈련 소요나 이런 것을 여타 공군 기지로 소산(疏散)할 수 있느냐”며 “소산 계획을 우리가 공군과 상의해서 짜면 그만큼 무안에 새로운 공항이 건설되는 것까지 기다리지 않고 이 터를 쓸 수 있다”고 했다. 광주 군공항의 장비와 시설을 우선 다른 공군 기지에 분산 배치하면, 전남 무안 등에 대체 공항이 완공되기 전에 반도체 클러스터 건설을 시작할 수 있다는 취지였다.)

However, experts analyze that there are many factors to consider in temporarily dispersing Gwangju Air Base's functions to other bases. The Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing, currently stationed at Gwangju Air Base, is primarily responsible for advanced flight training to produce fighter pilots. According to a Gwangju Chamber of Commerce and Industry announcement last year, out of approximately 9,100 annual takeoffs and landings at Gwangju Air Base as of 2024, 97%—or about 8,800—were pilot training flights. (그러나 전문가들 사이에서는 광주 군공항의 기능을 다른 기지로 임시 분산하는 데 고려할 점이 많다는 분석이 나오고 있다. 현재 광주 군공항에 주둔 중인 공군 제1전투비행단은 주로 전투기 조종사 양성을 위한 고등 비행 훈련을 담당한다. 지난해 광주상공회의소의 발표에 따르면, 2024년 기준으로 광주 군공항 연간 이착륙 횟수 9100여 회 가운데 97%인 8800여 회가 조종사 훈련 비행이었다.)

Hong Seong-pyo, a former air force officer and professor at Korea National Defense University who now serves as head of the Defense Policy Research Office at the Korea Military Research Institute, said, "Training aircraft have more frequent sortie schedules than regular fighter jets because they must produce pilots within a limited time." He added, "Other domestic air force bases are already operating near full capacity, so a 'short-term dispersal' will face difficulties." In this regard, the Gwangju Chamber of Commerce and Industry suggested to the presidential office last year that to resolve noise issues, the pilot training center should be "relocated overseas" when Gwangju Air Base moves. (공군 출신으로 국방대 교수를 지낸 홍성표 한국군사문제연구원 국방정책연구실장은 “훈련기는 제한된 시간에 조종사를 길러내야 하기 때문에 일반 전투기보다 출격 스케줄이 잦다”며 “국내 다른 공군 기지도 전력 운용이 포화 상태에 가깝기 때문에 ‘단기간 내 분산 배치’엔 무리가 따를 것”이라고 말했다. 이와 관련, 광주상의는 지난해 청와대에 소음 문제 해결을 위해 광주 군공항 이전 시 조종사 훈련센터는 ‘해외 이전’할 것을 건의했었다.)

The Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing is known to operate dozens of T-50 advanced trainers. Shin Jong-woo, secretary-general of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said, "It's questionable whether other air force bases have sufficient hangars or maintenance facilities to accommodate the training aircraft from Gwangju Air Base." He added, "It seems that forced measures are emerging because the situation requires hurriedly vacating the Gwangju Air Base facilities." (공군 제1전투비행단은 T-50 고등훈련기 수십 대를 운용 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 신종우 한국국방안보포럼 사무총장은 “광주 군공항에 있는 훈련기를 수용할 격납고나 정비 시설 등이 여타 공군 기지에 충분한지 의문”이라며 “광주 군공항 시설을 서둘러 빼야 하는 상황이 돼 무리한 대책이 등장하는 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

In this context, the office of People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Yong-won, a member of the National Assembly's National Defense Committee, analyzed on the 12th that "relocating pilot training infrastructure like the 1st Fighter Wing to another base would require at least a year and a half and costs exceeding tens of billions of won." It is reported that Gwangju Air Base also hosts over 10 simulator devices for flight training. To operate the simulators normally, they must be housed in buildings with consistent temperature and humidity, and the pure construction time for such buildings is at least 18 months. The lawmaker's office stated, "It has taken hundreds of billions of won over the past decade to build the current facilities at Gwangju Air Base. Proposing a 'temporary installation' elsewhere is close to wasting money." (이와 관련, 국회 국방위원회 소속 국민의힘 유용원 의원실은 12일 “제1비행단 같은 조종사 양성 인프라를 다른 기지로 옮기려면 최소 1년 반 이상의 기간과 수백억 원 이상의 비용이 소요된다”고 분석했다. 광주 군공항에는 모의 조종 훈련을 위한 시뮬레이터 기기도 10대 이상 배치돼 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 시뮬레이터 기기를 정상 운용하려면 온도·습도가 일정하게 유지되는 건물 안에 배치해야 하는데, 이런 건물을 짓는 순 공사 기간만 18개월 이상이라는 것이다. 유 의원실은 “현 광주 군공항의 관련 시설을 구축하는 데 지난 10여 년간 수백억 원이 들어갔다”며 “이걸 다른 곳에 ‘임시 설치’ 하자는 것은 돈 낭비에 가깝다”고 밝혔다.)

There are also criticisms that the presidential office may not have sufficiently consulted with the U.S. Forces Korea on the 'dispersal plan.' Gwangju Air Base is a joint ROK-U.S. air force operating base, serving as a hub for deploying U.S. air power during wartime or emergencies. On the 10th, a spokesperson for the U.S. 7th Air Force stated, "The U.S. 7th Air Force has significant military interests in Gwangju Base," and added, "We will continue to coordinate closely with the Republic of Korea Air Force to meet all requirements and maintain a strong combined readiness posture." (청와대가 ‘분산 배치’ 구상에 대해 주한미군 측과 충분히 상의하지 않은 것 아니냐는 지적도 있다. 광주 군공항은 한·미 공군 공동 운영 기지로서, 전시나 유사시엔 미 항공전력이 전개하는 거점 역할을 한다. 지난 10일 미 7공군 대변인은 “미 7공군은 광주 기지에 중요한 군사적 이해관계를 가지고 있다”며 “모든 요구 사항을 충족하고 강력한 연합 대비 태세를 유지하기 위해 대한민국 공군과 긴밀한 협조를 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Im Cheol-gyun, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for Strategic Studies, said, "The redistribution of resources at Gwangju Air Base, which includes U.S. military facilities, can only be carried out after close prior coordination with the U.S. Forces Korea." He added, "If building a semiconductor cluster causes disruption in ROK-U.S. military cooperation, it would be putting the cart before the horse." In response to these criticisms, the Ministry of National Defense stated that it would "support the government's policy to strengthen semiconductor industry competitiveness while striving to ensure no gaps in the ROK-U.S. combined defense posture, and will consult closely with the Air Force and the U.S. side." (임철균 한국전략문제연구소 전문연구위원은 “미군 시설이 있는 광주 군공항 자원의 재배치는 주한미군 측과 사전에 긴밀한 조율이 있어야만 이뤄질 수 있는 것”이라며 “반도체 클러스터를 짓기 위해 한·미 간 군사 협력에 차질이 생긴다면 본말이 전도되는 격”이라고 말했다. 이런 지적들과 관련, 국방부는 “정부의 반도체 산업 경쟁력 강화 정책에 부응하는 한편, 한미 연합 방위 태세에 공백이 없도록 노력하면서 공군, 미국 측과 긴밀히 협의해 나가겠다”는 입장을 밝혔다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo Says "Han Dong-hoon Should Not Even Come Near the People Power Party," Opposes His Return to the Party (안철수 “한동훈, 국힘에 얼씬도 말라” 복당 반대)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo Says "Han Dong-hoon Should Not Even Come Near the People Power Party," Opposes His Return to the Party (안철수 “한동훈, 국힘에 얼씬도 말라” 복당 반대)

People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo held a press conference at the National Assembly on the 12th opposing the reinstatement of lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, stating, "I hope Han will not even come near our party from now on." He added, "If Han is reinstated, the entire party will fall into factional conflict and wasteful internal strife, leading to a catastrophic situation where victory in the general election is out of reach." (안철수 국민의힘 의원이 12일 국회에서 ‘한동훈 의원 복당 반대’ 기자회견을 열고 “한 의원은 이제 우리 당에는 얼씬도 하지 말기 바란다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “한 의원이 복당하게 되면 당 전체는 계파 갈등과 소모적 내전에 빠질 것이며, 총선 승리는 엄두도 못 내는 파국의 상황으로 치달을 것”이라고 했다.)

Ahn cited a recent verbal clash with Han as the background for opposing his reinstatement. On the 8th, Ahn testified in court as a witness, stating that "it was then-party leader Han Dong-hoon who first told People Power Party lawmakers to gather at the party headquarters during the December 3 emergency martial law." In response, Han denied this as a "false claim," leading to a public confrontation between the two lawmakers. Han explained that he directed lawmakers to the party headquarters as a temporary assembly point after confirming the blockade during their move to the National Assembly. In response, Ahn said on the 12th, "Han acted as if I had distorted and incited things," adding, "Why must the history of that day become the heroic narrative of only one person, Han Dong-hoon?" He also called Han's criticism of his court testimony "a clear distribution of false information and defamation." <<> Some interpret Ahn's move, who is mentioned as a potential next party leader, as catering to the tastes of hardline anti-Han supporters. A People Power Party lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "From Ahn's perspective, holding the next party leadership election without Han's reinstatement likely seems to increase his chances of winning." There is also talk that this is a strategy to highlight his presence as a major contender. On the opposition side, competition has intensified with figures like Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who was re-elected in local elections, and lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who successfully entered the National Assembly. An opposition source noted, "According to recent poll trends, including party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, three figures show approval ratings around 10%, while Ahn remains stuck in the 5% range," adding, "Ahn's calculation might be to first show clarity to party members and secure the next party leadership, then win over the centrists." (안 의원은 한 의원 복당 반대 배경으로 최근 한 의원과 벌인 언쟁을 꼽았다. 안 의원은 지난 8일 법정에 증인으로 출석해 ‘12·3 비상계엄 당시 국민의힘 의원들에게 먼저 당사로 모이라고 한 것은 한동훈 당시 대표’라는 취지로 증언했다. 이를 두고 한 의원은 “허위 주장”이라고 반발하며 두 의원이 공개적으로 충돌했다. 한 의원은 ‘국회로 이동 중 봉쇄 상황이 확인돼 당사를 임시 집결지로 안내한 것’이란 취지로 설명했다. 이에 대해 안 의원은 이날 “한 의원은 마치 제가 왜곡과 선동을 한 것처럼 몰아갔다”며 “왜 그날의 역사가 오직 한동훈 한 사람의 영웅 서사가 돼야 하느냐”고 했다. 한 의원이 자신의 법정 증언을 비판한 것에 대해서도 “명백한 허위사실 유포이자 명예훼손”라고 했다.)

item.title: Worried about fading presence? Cho Kuk posts over 30 articles in a week (존재감 약해질까봐? 조국, 일주일새 글 30개 넘게 올려)
item.description:
Worried about fading presence? Cho Kuk posts over 30 articles in a week (존재감 약해질까봐? 조국, 일주일새 글 30개 넘게 올려)

Former leader of the Innovation Party, Cho Kuk, has been posting an average of about five Facebook posts per day even after failing to enter the National Assembly. In just the past week alone, he has written over 30 posts. (조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 국회 입성 실패 후에도 페이스북에 하루 평균 5개 안팎의 글을 올리고 있다. 최근 일주일 동안에만 30개 넘게 글을 썼다.)

On the 12th, Cho posted on Facebook expressing regret over the recent "Scary, no?" controversy in which he had participated and helped escalate. The "Scary, no?" dispute arose when some criticized the idol group Riize member Wonhee's use of the phrase "Scary, no?" on YouTube as a degrading Ilbe-style expression mocking former President Roh Moo-hyun. Cho joined the fray on the 5th, further amplifying the criticism against Riize. On that day, Cho wrote, "I never said Riize is Ilbe. Riize, yaho!" In response, the People Power Party said, "Cho is making a petty excuse a week later. He should show restraint." Recently, Cho’s Facebook critiques have targeted not only the opposition but also the ruling party, including President Lee Jae-myung. (조 전 대표는 12일 페이스북에 최근 자신이 참전해 키운 ‘무섭노’ 논란과 관련해 유감을 표명했다. 무섭노 논란은 아이돌 그룹 리센느의 멤버 원이가 유튜브에서 사용한 “무섭노”라는 표현을 두고 일각에서 노무현 전 대통령을 희화화하는 일베식 표현이라고 공격하면서 벌어졌다. 여기에 조 전 대표가 지난 5일 가세하며 리센느에 대한 비판이 일파만파로 확산됐다. 조 전 대표는 이날 “리센느가 일베라고 한 적은 없다”며 “리센느, 야호!”라고 썼다. 이에 대해 국민의힘은 “조 전 대표가 일주일이나 지나 치졸하게 발뺌하는 것”이라며 “그만 자중하시라”고 했다. 최근 페이스북에서 조 전 대표의 비판 대상은 야권뿐 아니라 이재명 대통령 등 여권으로도 향해있다.)

This behavior by Cho is interpreted as an effort to assert his presence. In the June 3 by-election for Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, a five-way race for a National Assembly seat, Cho lost to People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Eui-dong and also fell to third place behind the Democratic Party candidate. Since then, voices within his party have called for a name change, and even proposals of merging into the Democratic Party before the 2028 general election have emerged. A ruling party source remarked, "With intense power struggles among Democratic Party heavyweights like Kim Min-seok, Jeong Cheong-rae, and Song Young-gil, isn't he afraid of losing public attention? Especially, he might think he is the true successor of the pro-Roh, pro-Moon mainstream." Some figures reportedly advised him to go abroad temporarily to distance himself from politics, but Cho declined. However, an associate of Cho stated, "It’s not anxiety about being forgotten, but simply his nature of not tolerating injustice." (조 전 대표의 이런 행보는 존재감을 과시하기 위한 것이란 해석이 나온다. 5파전으로 치러진 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 조 전 대표는 국민의힘 유의동 의원에게 밀려 낙선했다. 민주당 후보에게도 져 3위로 떨어졌다. 이후 당내에선 당명 개정 목소리와 함께 2028년 총선 전 민주당으로 흡수 합당 주장까지 나오는 것으로 알려졌다. 여권 관계자는 “민주당 김민석·정청래·송영길 등 빅샷 간 당권 싸움이 치열한 상황에서 대중의 관심에서 멀어질까 두려운 마음 아니겠냐”며 “특히 민주당 핵심 주류인 친노·친문 적자는 자신이라는 생각도 하지 않겠냐”고 했다. 일부 인사는 “잠시 정치권과 멀리 지내야 한다”며 해외 출국을 권유하기도 했지만, 조 전 대표는 거절한 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 조 전 대표 측 관계자는 “잊히기 싫다는 조바심은 아니고 그저 불의를 참지 못하는 성격 때문”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil: "We Must Adopt Preferential Voting" Jung Cheong-rae: "I Will Endure Even If Ganged Up On" (김민석·송영길 “선호투표로 가야” 정청래 “다구리 맞아도 견딜 것”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil: "We Must Adopt Preferential Voting" Jung Cheong-rae: "I Will Endure Even If Ganged Up On" (김민석·송영길 “선호투표로 가야” 정청래 “다구리 맞아도 견딜 것”)

The escalating factional conflict within the Democratic Party of Korea intensified over the weekend as party leadership contenders engaged in a war of words regarding the adoption of a preferential voting system for the August 17th National Convention to elect the party leader. Pro-Myung (pro-Lee Jae-myung) candidates urged former Representative Jung Cheong-rae to accept the preferential voting system, while Jung countered, accusing those demanding the system of "ganging up" on him. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 선호투표제를 적용할지 여부를 두고 당권 주자들이 주말 내내 설전을 벌이며 계파 간 갈등이 격화됐다. 친명(친이재명)계 후보들은 정청래 전 대표를 향해 선호투표제를 수용하라고 요구한 반면, 정 전 대표는 선호투표제를 요구하는 쪽이 자신을 ‘다구리(몰매)’하고 있다고 맞섰다.)

The Democratic Party discussed whether to introduce a preferential voting system at a Supreme Council meeting on the 12th but failed to reach a conclusion. While Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do proposed amending party rules to stipulate the 'preferential voting system' as one method for electing the party leader, pro-Cheong (pro-Jung Cheong-rae) Supreme Council members opposed, arguing that "party member opinions should be gathered first," preventing an agreement. Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun stated immediately after the adjournment of the Supreme Council meeting, "With various discords within the party ahead of the national convention, we apologize to the party members and the public." (민주당은 12일 최고위원회의에서 선호투표제 도입 여부를 논의했지만 결론을 내지 못했다. 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 당규를 개정해 당대표 선출 방법 중 하나로 ‘선호투표제’를 명시하자고 제안했지만, 친청(친정청래)계 최고위원들이 “당원 의견 수렴이 먼저”라고 맞서면서 합의에 이르지 못했다. 강준현 수석대변인은 최고위 산회 직후 “전당대회를 앞두고 당내 여러 가지 불협화음이 있어 당원들과 국민들께 죄송한 마음”이라고 했다.)

The preferential voting system is a method where voters rank all candidates, and if no candidate receives a majority, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and the votes from those who ranked that candidate first are redistributed to their second-choice candidate. Earlier, on the 7th, the party's convention preparation committee resolved to introduce a preferential voting system and a youth supreme council member system, but the pro-Cheong faction, holding a majority on the Supreme Council, objected, calling it a "violation of the party constitution and rules," delaying the Supreme Council's decision. There is an interpretation that applying the preferential voting system in a situation where pro-Myung candidates are numerous would disadvantage former Representative Jung Cheong-rae. The Democratic Party has decided to reach a final conclusion at the Supreme Council meeting by the 15th at the latest. The registration period for party leader candidates is the 16th and 17th. (선호투표제는 유권자가 모든 후보에 대해 순위를 정해 투표한 뒤, 과반 득표자가 없으면 최하위 후보를 탈락시키고 그 후보를 1순위로 뽑은 유권자 표를 2순위 후보에게 합치는 방식이다. 앞서 민주당 전준위는 지난 7일 선호투표제 및 청년최고위원제 도입을 의결했지만, 최고위 과반을 차지한 친청계가 “당헌·당규 위반”이라고 반발하면서 최고위 결정이 미뤄져 왔다. 친명계 후보가 다수인 상황에서 선호투표제를 적용하면 정청래 전 대표에게 불리할 것이란 해석도 나온다. 민주당은 늦어도 15일 최고위에서 최종 결론을 내기로 했다. 당대표 후보 등록일은 16~17일이다.)

The party leadership contenders also engaged in verbal sparring. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok wrote on X (formerly Twitter) on the 11th, "Respecting the opinions of the party and the convention preparation committee while avoiding advantages or disadvantages for specific candidates has been a long tradition of the Democratic Party's internal elections," and "I respect the position and will of the convention preparation committee regarding the preferential vote, which poses no problem under the party constitution, rules, or customs, and the introduction of a youth supreme council member for the party's future." Rep. Song Young-gil also posted on Facebook on the 12th, stating, "It is not the right attitude for an athlete on the field to question the rules," and "Stopping the party's procedures due to advantages or disadvantages for a specific candidate is a denial of party member sovereignty." (당권 주자들도 설전을 벌였다. 김민석 전 국무총리는 지난 11일 X(옛 트위터)에 “특정 후보의 유불리를 피하면서 당과 전준위 의견을 존중해 온 것이 민주당 당내 선거의 오랜 전통”이라면서 “당헌·당규상으로도, 관례상으로도 문제가 없는 선호투표와 당의 미래를 위한 청년최고위원 도입에 대한 전준위의 입장과 의지를 존중한다”고 했다. 송영길 의원도 12일 페이스북 글에서 “경기장에 선 선수가 룰을 문제 삼는 것은 옳은 태도가 아니다”라면서 “특정 후보의 유불리를 이유로 당의 절차를 멈춰 세우는 것이야말로 당원 주권에 대한 부정”이라고 했다.)

On the same day, former Rep. Jung shared an internet media cartoon on Facebook that depicted the pro-Myung faction's offensive regarding the preferential voting system as 'ganging up,' adding, "It hurts a lot when you get beaten. I will try to endure well." He had previously stated multiple times, "The preferential voting system has potential to violate the party constitution and rules." (정 전 대표는 이날 선호투표제와 관련한 친명계의 공세를 ‘다구리’로 표현한 인터넷 매체의 만평을 페이스북에 공유하면서 “두들겨 맞으면 많이 아프다. 잘 견뎌 보겠다”고 했다. 그는 앞서 여러 차례 “선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반 소지가 있다”고 했다.)

Former Rep. Jung targeted former Prime Minister Kim, saying, "The worst kind of self-serving politics is the outdated practice of leaving the party during an election to run as an independent or support a candidate from another party." This was a jab at Kim's past record of leaving the Democratic Party to support candidate Chung Mong-joon during the 2002 presidential election. (정 전 대표는 이날 김 전 총리를 겨냥해 “최악의 자기 정치는 선거 때 탈당해서 무소속 출마하거나 남의 당 후보를 돕는 구태 정치”라고 말했다. 김 전 총리가 2002년 대선 당시 민주당을 탈당해 정몽준 후보를 지원한 전력을 저격한 것이다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim struck back by publicly disclosing hospital and pharmacy prescriptions in response to an attack from pro-Cheong Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon, who demanded Kim reveal "the ingredients of the cold medicine he took on the day of the December 3rd martial law declaration." Kim retorted, "Rep. Lee is not a pharmacist, so why is he interested in drug ingredients?" and "Continuing to raise issues even after I've shown everything is like the actions of a prosecutor in the Daejang-dong case." (김 전 총리는 “12·3 비상계엄 당일 먹은 감기약 성분을 밝히라”는 친청계 이성윤 최고위원의 공세에 당시 병원과 약국 처방전을 공개하며 반격했다. 김 전 총리는 “이 의원은 약사도 아닌데 약 성분에 관심이 있느냐”면서 “다 보여줬는데도 문제를 계속 제기하는 것은 대장동 검사 같은 짓”이라고 했다.)

Major party leadership contenders spent the weekend touring regions and meeting voters. Former Rep. Jung visited Chungcheong, his hometown and the site of the first regional primary for the Democratic Party's national convention, for two consecutive days. Former Prime Minister Kim met with party members in Yongin and Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, while Rep. Song held town hall meetings with party members in Iksan, North Jeolla Province, and northern Gyeonggi Province. Rep. Song also emphasized the necessity of the success of the Honam semiconductor cluster, stating, "I will remain stationed in the Honam region until party leader election day." The five candidates running in the party leadership election, including the three figures, Rep. Ko Min-jung, and former Gangjin County Council Chair Kim Bo-mi, attended the 'National Autonomy and Decentralization Democratic Leadership Conference (KDLC)' held at the National Assembly on this day and delivered their policy addresses. (주요 당권 주자들은 주말 내내 지역을 돌며 유권자를 만났다. 정 전 대표는 자신의 고향이자 민주당 전당대회 첫 순회 경선 지역인 충청을 이틀 연속 방문했다. 김 전 총리는 경기 용인·성남에서 당원을 만났고, 송 의원은 전북 익산과 경기 북부에서 당원들과 타운홀 미팅을 가졌다. 송 의원은 이날 호남 반도체 클러스터 성공의 필요성을 강조하며 “당대표 선거일까지 호남에서 상주하겠다”고 밝히기도 했다. 세 사람을 비롯해 고민정 의원, 김보미 전 강진군의회 의장 등 당대표 선거에 출마하는 5명은 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘전국자치분권민주지도자회의(KDLC)’에 나란히 참석해 정견 발표에 나섰다.)

The matchups for the Supreme Council election, held concurrently with the party leadership race, are also taking shape. On this day, pro-Myung Rep. Park Seong-joon declared his candidacy for a Supreme Council seat. Regarding the leadership of Jung Cheong-rae, Rep. Park stated, "It has lost its leadership," and argued, "There is no clear presentation of what the party should do or what tasks it should undertake. It is a state of disarray." (당대표 선거와 함께 치러지는 최고위원 선거 대진표도 윤곽을 드러내고 있다. 이날은 친명계 박성준 의원이 최고위원 출마를 선언했다. 박 의원은 정청래 지도부에 대해 “리더십을 잃었다”면서 “당이 무엇을 해야 하는지, 어떤 일을 해야 하는지에 대한 명확한 제시가 없다. 난맥상”이라고 했다.)

So far, on the pro-Myung side, Reps. Kim Young-ho, Lee Geon-tae, Seo Mi-hwa, Park Seon-won, and former Democratic Research Institute Deputy Director Kim Yong have declared their candidacies for the Supreme Council. On the pro-Cheong side, Reps. Lee Seong-yoon, Han Min-soo, and Choi Min-hee are contemplating running. (현재까지 친명계에선 김영호·이건태·서미화·박선원 의원, 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장이 최고위원 출마를 선언했다. 친청계에선 이성윤·한민수·최민희 의원 등이 출마를 고심 중이다.)

item.title: "Jang Yoon-gi incidents, which occur several times a year, why are they reported so much?" — Kim Eo-jun (“1년에 몇건씩 나는 장윤기 사건, 왜 이리 보도 많나”는 김어준)
item.description:
"Jang Yoon-gi incidents, which occur several times a year, why are they reported so much?" — Kim Eo-jun (“1년에 몇건씩 나는 장윤기 사건, 왜 이리 보도 많나”는 김어준)

Pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-jun claimed on his YouTube channel on the 9th regarding the Jang Yoon-gi incident in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province, "Incidents of this caliber occur several times a year. (Yet) why is this being reported so extensively?" and "They are using the Jang Yoon-gi incident to sway public opinion, arguing that the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers should not be abolished." Kim has been endorsing the hardline faction of the Democratic Party by advocating for prosecution reforms, such as abolishing the prosecution service. Recently, as the Jang Yoon-gi case sparked cautious voices within the ruling party against abolishing these powers, Kim framed this as media-driven manipulation of public opinion. <<> Since then, within the Democratic Party, voices led by hardliners are emerging, saying, "The Jang Yoon-gi incident and the issue of abolishing supplementary investigation powers should not be linked." Choo Mi-ae, a Democratic Party member and Gyeonggi Province Governor, posted on Facebook on the 11th, referencing the Jang Yoon-gi case, "The destruction of evidence in a murder case involving a police officer's son is a problem of failing to avoid conflicts of interest, not an issue of separating investigation and prosecution." She argued, "We must not waver on the final ridge of prosecution reform." Governor Choo, who previously served as chairman of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee and led efforts to abolish the prosecution service, reiterated her call for the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. She added, "Even if there is some distrust and unease about the police taking charge of investigations, that cannot be an excuse to delay the reform of a prosecution service that usurped democratic constitutionalism." <<> Jeong Cheong-rae, a former Democratic Party leader and candidate for party leadership, stated on the 12th during a policy speech at the National Conference for Decentralization and Democratic Leaders (KDLC), "I am in principle in favor of reform, but delaying for more deliberation is essentially opposing reform." He argued, "The right to request supplementary investigations is sufficient; the complete and total abolition of investigation powers and supplementary investigation powers—down to the last drop—is the correct answer." He added, "The Democratic Party fails if it cannot carry out reform." <<> Lawmaker Kim Yong-min also posted on Facebook on the same day, regarding concerns within the ruling party about abolishing supplementary investigation powers, "This follows a similar trend to when the prosecution's direct investigation powers were abolished four years ago." He implied that during the Moon Jae-in administration, the so-called "complete stripping of prosecution investigation powers" was pushed aside by moderate voices and failed to advance, arguing that this time the abolition of supplementary investigation powers must be achieved. Lawmaker Kim recalled in 2022, "All media and pro-prosecution experts appeared, criticizing prosecution reform, and under that pressure, we ended up retaining two of the six major crime categories. The aftermath of that was a coup d'état." (친여 유튜버 김어준씨가 지난 9일 유튜브에서 전남광주 장윤기 사건을 두고 “이런 정도의 사건은 1년에 몇 건씩이나 있다. (그런데) 이게 왜 이렇게까지 많이 보도되지”라며 “장윤기 사건을 가지고 검찰의 보완수사권을 폐지하면 안 된다고 여론몰이를 하고 있는 것”이라고 주장했다. 김씨는 그동안 검찰청 폐지 등 검찰 개편 방향을 제시하며 민주당 강경파에 힘을 실어왔는데, 최근 장윤기 사건을 계기로 여권 내 폐지 신중론이 나오자 이를 언론의 여론몰이로 규정한 것이다.)

item.title: Presidential Committee on National Integration Chair: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Authority is Unconstitutional" (국민통합위원장 “검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 위헌”)
item.description:
Presidential Committee on National Integration Chair: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Authority is Unconstitutional" (국민통합위원장 “검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 위헌”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chair of the Presidential Committee on National Integration, stated on the 12th, "The complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority violates the Constitution." This marks the first time a current administration official has claimed unconstitutionality regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push to amend the Criminal Procedure Act to abolish supplementary investigation authority. The Supreme Court's Administrative Office also recently submitted an opinion to the National Assembly, stating that while "it is a matter to be decided by legislation," "supplementary measures to prevent side effects should also be prepared." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장은 12일 “검사의 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 헌법에 위배된다”고 밝혔다. 현 정부 인사가 더불어민주당의 보완수사권 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정 추진과 관련해 위헌 주장을 한 것은 처음이다. 대법원 법원행정처도 최근 국회에 “입법으로 결정할 사항”이라면서도 “부작용을 막기 위한 보완 방안이 함께 마련돼야 한다”는 의견을 제출했다.)

Chairman Lee, a former Minister of Government Legislation, wrote on Facebook that day, "Although the Constitution does not prevent the abolition of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office to disperse prosecutors' authority, the complete deprivation of investigation authority from prosecutors as subjects of investigation contradicts the principle of systemic legitimacy of the Constitution and is subject to unconstitutionality. To completely strip prosecutors of their investigation authority, either the Constitution must be amended to transfer warrant application rights to investigative agencies instead of prosecutors, as in the inaugural Constitution, or it must be delegated by law." (법제처장 출신인 이 위원장은 이날 페이스북에 “헌법은 비록 검찰청을 폐지하여 검사의 권한을 분산하는 것까지는 막고 있지 않지만, 수사의 주체로서의 검사가 가진 수사권의 완전 박탈은 헌법의 체계 정당성의 원리에 반하여 위헌의 소지가 있다”며 “검사의 수사권을 완전 박탈하기 위해서는 헌법을 개정해 영장신청권을 제헌헌법처럼 검사 대신 수사기관으로 고치든지 아니면 법률에 위임해야 한다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party maintains its stance of "fundamental direction toward complete abolition," aiming to pass the amended Criminal Procedure Act in the National Assembly plenary session before the August 17 party convention. However, cautious voices are growing internally. A key leadership official said, "As discussions proceed, various supplementary measures could be developed, and if they are deemed reasonable, they could be accepted." (민주당은 “기본 방향은 전면 폐지”라며 8·17 전당대회 전 형사소송법 개정안을 국회 본회의에서 처리하겠다는 입장이다. 다만 내부에선 신중론이 커지고 있다. 지도부 핵심 관계자는 “논의하다보면 여러 보완책들이 마련될 수 있고, 그게 합리적이라고 하면 수용할 수도 있다고 본다”고 했다.)

◇Within the Ruling Party: "Amendment Bill is Serious… Should Not Be Lightly Treated as Material for Party Sentiment Confrontation" (◇與 내부선 “개정 법안 심각… 당심 대결 소재로 가볍게 다루면 안돼”)

In the ruling party, following the Jang Yun-gi incident in Gwangju, Jeonnam province, which highlighted poor police investigations, calls to reconsider the abolition are continuing. It is known that even within the Democratic Party leadership, while abolition is the principle, the need to revisit the timing of the amendment's passage and supplementary measures has been raised. (여권에선 전남광주 장윤기 사건을 계기로 경찰의 부실 수사 등이 부각되자 폐지를 재검토해야 한다는 주장이 이어지고 있다. 민주당 지도부 내에서도 폐지를 원칙으로 하되, 개정안 처리 시점과 보완책 등에 대한 재논의 필요성이 제기되는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Chairman Lee Seok-yeon stated on that day, "The current Constitution designates the right to apply for arrest warrants, detention warrants, and search and seizure warrants—core investigative powers—as the exclusive and monopolistic authority of prosecutors." Articles 12(3) and 16 of the Constitution, which Chairman Lee referenced, explicitly name prosecutors as the subject of warrant applications. Chairman Lee added, "A responsible political party should not abandon fundamental principles for the future of the community in the name of reform, depending on the immediate reactions of its support base or partisan interests." Regarding the Democratic Party's push for a 'supplementary investigation demand right,' he said in a phone interview with this publication, "If the prosecution tells the police to do this and that in a ping-pong fashion, citizens will inevitably suffer due to issues like the statute of limitations for prosecution." Chairman Lee, a conservative figure who served as Minister of Government Legislation under the Lee Myung-bak administration, was recruited by President Lee Jae-myung during the last presidential election.
